description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits an experienced Marketing Director to join a recently acquired skilled nursing facility. This pivotal leadership role is ideal for a dynamic professional eager to make a significant impact on census growth and community engagement. You will be instrumental in shaping the facility's market presence and driving its success.

We are seeking a highly presentable and results-driven individual with a strong work ethic and proactive approach. The ideal candidate will possess the drive to excel and the flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed. This role offers competitive compensation for the right candidate who can demonstrate a proven track record of success in healthcare marketing.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and implement effective marketing strategies
Strong professional presence and excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Results-driven with a proactive approach and strong initiative
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Pays well for the right person
